front: Why use cDNA for expression arrays?
back: mRNA shows which genes are transcribed; it is copied into more stable, labelled cDNA by reverse transcriptase.
Collection, storage and analysis of biological data (sequences, structures) using computers and databases.

front: Benefits of sequence and structure databases
back: Compare sequences (evolution), identify genes and functions, track pathogens, design drugs, share data.
Analysing genomes (which sequences or alleles are present) and detecting mRNA (gene expression).
